facts.text: The hotel sits on Elizabeth Quay, where the Swan River meets the city of Perth.
facts.excerpt: Set on Elizabeth Quay where the Swan River meets the city,
The Ritz-Carlton, Perth opened its doors in November 2019.

facts.text: The Chef’s Counter seats only six guests each evening for a dining experience built around local land and sea.
facts.excerpt: With only six guests each evening, savour an immersive journey crafted before your eyes, celebrating the finest local land and sea.

facts.text: Hearth Restaurant cooks with open fire and celebrates local producers from Western Australia to the Great Southern regions.
facts.excerpt: Harnessing the power of nature and an open fire, billows of smoke and glowing embers, Hearth Restaurant in Perth CBD celebrates local producers from Western Australia to the Great Southern regions

facts.text: Songbird is the hotel’s rooftop bar, with panoramic Swan River views.
facts.excerpt: Songbird, our rooftop bar in Perth CBD, invites you to escape the city bustle and savor glamorous cocktails, panoramic Swan River views and golden sunsets

facts.text: The heated outdoor infinity pool looks out over the Swan River and city skyline.
facts.excerpt: heated outdoor infinity pool looks out over the Swan River and city skyline

facts.text: The spa works with the skincare brands LaGaia Unedited and Biologique Recherche on its treatments.
facts.excerpt: works collaboratively with national and international skincare brands LaGaia Unedited and Biologique Recherche on its bespoke spa treatments

facts.text: The spa has four treatment rooms, including a couple’s spa suite.
facts.excerpt: Four idyllic treatment rooms, including a couple’s spa suite,

facts.text: Every room has a bathroom with a dual vanity and a standalone tub.
facts.excerpt: All of our luxury hotel rooms, include a spacious bathroom with dual vanity and standalone tub.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a master bedroom, private study, balcony, and a separate living and dining room with a butler’s kitchen.
facts.excerpt: This suite overlooking the Swan River features a master bedroom, private study, spacious balcony, and a separate living and dining room with a butler’s kitchen.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club offers a dedicated concierge and a private Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Club enhances your entire stay by providing a dedicated Concierge, a private Club Lounge, unique in-room amenities and exclusive experiences

facts.text: Ritz Kids gives young guests a personalised check-in and an Adventurer Passport to explore the hotel.
facts.excerpt: invites young guests to embark on their own adventure, beginning with a personalised check-in and Adventurer Passport to explore the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel offers a full-day Margaret River journey with winery tastings and a seasonal lunch.
facts.excerpt: Discover Margaret River on a full-day journey across Wadandi land, where vineyards, forests and coastline converge. Enjoy curated tastings at boutique wineries, followed by a seasonal lunch

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton, Perth.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide it for free.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2022, 2023 and 2026.
